Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Lost Relay]]: the poster of the 1968 film ''2001: A Space Odyssey''.

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:2001_A_Space_Odyssey_(1968).png 2001 A Space Odyssey (1968).png], Wikipedia, shown on the Wikipedia article [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2001:_A_Space_Odyssey 2001: A Space Odyssey]. Preserved copy of the article: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261023094625/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2001:_A_Space_Odyssey Internet Archive], 23 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a reduced copy (300 pixels tall) of the poster of the 1968 film ''2001: A Space Odyssey'', the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of the work exists.
